verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions React Email, MJML, or any first-party email-as-code framework. It also says nothing about keeping templates in version control. The Templates API (create/fetch/update/delete) is a developer building block a user could script against from a repo, not the documented code-authoring capability the story asks for, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can author emails as code — React Email, MJML, or an equivalent maintained framework the vendor documents first-party — and keep templates in version control
